name: B10-0362/2025 (ECR) – Governance of the internet – renewal of the mandate of the Internet Governance Forum
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on governance of the internet – renewal of the mandate of the Internet Governance Forum
part_text:
The European Parliament is asking the United Nations to renew the mandate of the Internet Governance Forum, the body where governments, companies, experts and civil society discuss how the internet is run. It wants the mandate made permanent, with more resources, and it wants the forum to stay open to everyone rather than controlled by governments alone. It also calls for defending free expression, privacy and access to information online. This is an opinion; it does not change any law.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament asks the UN to make the forum permanent and better funded.
- **Who it affects:** Governments, companies, civil society and internet users worldwide.
- **What happens next:** The UN review decides whether to renew the mandate; Parliament wants a strong EU role.
